universe.name: Marvel Universe: Concise Continuity
universe.description: A curated, fixed-timeline Marvel continuity where real-world present day is in-universe present day. Cherry-picked, but additive: everything currently in this file — every character, every costume/variant, every timeline event — is canon, something that actually happened in this universe. Nothing here is a hypothetical alternate to pick between. The only way something leaves is an explicit retcon (removed on request), not by default. Edit universe.timelineAnchor, each character's events, and stories[] to keep building it out.

timelineAnchor.note: Real time = story time. Update currentYear each year, or compute it in js/app.js from Date(). Chronology logic: Iron Man / the founding Avengers are well-established (debut ~15 years before currentYear). Peter Parker and Johnny Storm are both ~26 in the current year and got their powers as teenagers, so their eras land later, close together. The timeline pages group events by year — multiple things that happened the same year stack inside one point instead of spreading across several.

characters.name: Peter Parker
characters.bioShort: Bitten by a radioactive/genetically-modified spider as a teenager — a newer hero than the founding Avengers, anchored at 26 years old in the current year. Tonally, his corner of the universe plays like the '90s animated series: a rotating rogues gallery, a supporting cast that matters, and consequences that stick.
characters.bioLong: Gains his powers at 16 and starts out small-scale and local before the Avengers-level stuff finds him. A meteor crash later brings an alien symbiote into his life — he wears it as a black suit for a while, stronger and more aggressive, until its influence over him gets to be too much and he tears it off. He doesn't destroy it. It finds Eddie Brock instead, and that becomes someone else's story (see Venom). Separately, Norman Osborn — already established as the Green Goblin, already fixated on Peter — runs a cloning experiment on him, producing two clones: Ben and Kaine. Unlike the classic Clone Saga, this doesn't spiral into a years-long identity crisis — no Jackal pulling strings behind it, no protracted 'which one is the real Peter' arc. Ben mostly just... helps. Steps in for Peter when he's overwhelmed or needs to be two places at once, and the two of them end up with something like a brotherly bond instead of a rivalry. Kaine's arc is rougher and less resolved. The rogues gallery — Green Goblin, Doc Ock, Vulture, and the rest — is fully active across this whole span.

characters.name: Eddie Brock
characters.bioShort: A journalist rival of Peter Parker's who bonds with the alien symbiote after Spider-Man rejects it. Shares Spider-Man's powers, and his hatred of Peter runs deep.
characters.bioLong: PLACEHOLDER — Eddie Brock's own downfall (the specific grudge against Peter — a ruined story, a public humiliation, whatever you want on record) is still unwritten. What's set: the symbiote Peter discarded in 2021 found Eddie, who — unlike Peter — bonded with it willingly and let it take hold. The result is Venom: spider-powers, no restraint, and a fixation on destroying the man who rejected the very thing that made him.

variants.label: Venom — Classic
variants.description: The symbiote, formerly Spider-Man's black suit, fully bonded to Eddie Brock.

timelineEvents.title: Bonds with the rejected symbiote, becomes Venom
timelineEvents.summary: Picks up the suit Spider-Man tore off and discarded — this time, a willing bond.

characters.name: Cletus Kasady
characters.bioShort: A spawn of Eddie Brock's symbiote, bonded to a violent serial killer. Considerably less restrained than Venom.
characters.bioLong: PLACEHOLDER — the specifics of Kasady and Brock's overlap (prison? hospital?) are unwritten. What's set: the Venom symbiote produces an offshoot that bonds directly to Cletus Kasady's bloodstream, making the two inseparable in a way even Eddie and his symbiote aren't. Meaner, redder, and far less interested in restraint.
